title: Ideas for Horror Films, Each Made Into a Real Short
summary: 10 ideas for horror films, from creatures and ghosts to obsession and found footage, each shown with the real horror shot a filmmaker made from it in Flick.
body_markdown:
### What are good ideas for horror films?


Good ideas for horror films trap a few people in one place with one threat they do not understand, such as hunters in a cave whose wall turns out to be living tissue, or a man whose wish for love comes true too well.


### How do I come up with a horror movie idea?


Start from one ordinary thing you trust, such as a window, your own body or someone who loves you, then break one rule about it. A horror movie idea that fits in a sentence is usually small enough to shoot.


### What are the main types of horror films?


The main types of horror films include creature features, body horror, ghost stories, psychological horror, folk horror, slashers and found footage. Many strong films mix two, such as a ghost story told as found footage.


### What makes a horror idea scary rather than just gross?


A horror idea is scary when the audience understands the threat's rule but cannot see all of it, so they imagine the worst. Gore shows everything at once, which leaves nothing for the audience to fear next.


### Can I make a horror short film with AI?


Yes. In Flick one person can write the premise, design the creature or ghost, generate every shot with sound and cut the short on one canvas, as residency filmmakers did for films such as Tusk Hunters and In 'twixt Vows.


### Is there a horror movie idea generator?


Yes. The Flick[film idea generator](https://flick.art/tools/film-idea-generator) suggests premises from a genre and a few words, so you can ask it for horror and then build the film from the idea on the same canvas.


### Can I use these horror film ideas for my own film?


Yes, a premise is free to borrow as a starting point, but the films, their characters and their images belong to the filmmakers who made them, so make the idea your own.
